Priscilla Ferreira  
San Francisco, CA | (555) 123-4567 | priscilla.ferreira@email.com | linkedin.com/in/priscillaferreira  

A Staff Site Reliability Engineer with a decade of experience building scalable cloud infrastructures, automating operations, and optimizing system reliability. Focused on aligning engineering practices with business goals through measurable improvements in cost, performance, and resilience.  

**Technical Skills**  
- **Cloud Infrastructure**: AWS architecture design, VPC/subnet optimization, cost reduction strategies, cross-team collaboration on multi-cloud strategies  
- **Kubernetes**: Cluster management, automation of deployment pipelines, mentorship on best practices, integration with monitoring tools  
- **CI/CD**: Ownership of pipelines for microservices, 30% reduction in deployment time, integration with security scanning tools  
- **Monitoring & Alerting**: Custom dashboards with Prometheus/Grafana, incident response frameworks, integration with Slack/Teams  
- **Terraform**: Infrastructure-as-code standardization, reduction of manual errors by 40%, team training on state management  
- **Database Optimization**: PostgreSQL query tuning, index strategy improvements, 25% latency reduction in critical workloads  
- **Service Mesh**: Istio implementation for service-to-service communication, observability enhancements, security policy enforcement  
- **Network Automation**: Ansible-driven configuration management, reduction of configuration drift, integration with cloud providers  
- **Python**: Scripting for automation, data analysis for performance bottlenecks, integration with existing tooling  
- **Cloud Networking**: Design of secure, scalable VPCs, optimization of routing rules, cost savings through subnet consolidation  

**Professional Experience**  
*NexaTech Solutions* | Staff Site Reliability Engineer (2019–present)  
Led the migration of monolithic applications to Kubernetes, reducing deployment time by 30% and improving system reliability. Designed Terraform modules for repeatable infrastructure, standardizing 80% of onboarding workflows. Implemented Prometheus/Grafana for real-time monitoring, decreasing incident resolution time by 25%.  

*DataFlow Systems* | Senior DevOps Engineer (2017–2019)  
Architected a cloud cost optimization strategy, achieving $2M annual savings through reserved instance utilization and spot fleet management. Automated network configurations using Ansible, reducing manual effort by 40% across 15+ environments.  

*CloudSolutions Ltd* | DevOps Engineer (2015–2017)  
Built CI/CD pipelines for 12+ microservices, integrating security scanning and automated testing. Pioneered PostgreSQL optimization techniques, improving query performance by 25% in high-traffic applications.  

*TechNova Inc* | Junior DevOps Engineer (2013–2015)  
Supported infrastructure scaling for SaaS products, gaining hands-on experience with AWS and open-source tools.  

**Projects**  
- **Kubernetes Cluster Modernization**: Redesigned cluster architecture to support hybrid workloads, increasing scalability by 50% and reducing downtime during upgrades.  
- **Cloud Cost Dashboard**: Developed a centralized tool for cost tracking, enabling teams to identify underutilized resources and optimize spending.  
- **Prometheus Alerting Framework**: Built custom alerting rules for critical metrics, reducing false positives by 60% and improving incident detection.  

**Education**  
*Master of Science in Computer Science* | University of Technology Sydney (2016)
